content.ascii:
[P2] Review and presentation are separate
|
|-- Candidate: retained immutable revision
|   `-- available for review, presentation, or both
|-- Review: revisionReviews[id] records base/head/revisions
|   |-- owner/scope and accept or reject per change
|   |-- save decisions without changing bound content
|   `-- apply: check structural dependencies and conflicts
|       `-- preserve unrelated edits; update bound content
|-- Presentation: promote pinned scope to an alternative
|   `-- select or compare; bound content stays fixed
`-- Optional alternative.reviewId links the two

AgentChat variant retains a candidate and review; an alternative
is optional. Application and selection are explicit operations.
Undo/history captures operations; revision payloads stay immutable.
